articles.title: Agra: Gwalior Man Arrested for Rs 25 Lakh Cyber Fraud Using Fake Profiles and Trading Scams
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 38-year-old man from Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, was arrested in Agra for allegedly defrauding people of Rs 20–25 lakh through cyber scams. The accused, Durgesh Singh Tomar, a B.Com graduate, used two main methods to cheat victims.

body.html:
A 38-year-old man from Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, was arrested in Agra for allegedly defrauding people of Rs 20–25 lakh through cyber scams. The accused, Durgesh Singh Tomar, a B.Com graduate, used two main methods to cheat victims.

In one method, Tomar created fake female social media profiles and used a woman's voice to lure men into online relationships. Once emotionally involved, he sent them fake nude photos and blackmailed them for money.

In the second method, he ran a Telegram group called 'Robotxauusdfx', offering fake online trading tutorials promising high returns. He controlled the victims’ trading accounts and duped 15–20 people with the help of an accomplice, Manoj Dubey.

Tomar used forged PAN and Aadhaar cards to open multiple bank accounts for receiving funds. Nine complaints against him are registered across various states.

An FIR has been lodged under BNS sections 318(4) (cheating), 337 (forgery), and relevant sections of the IT Act. He was arrested by a team led by ACP Hariparwat Vinayak Bhonsale and will be produced in court.

articles.title: Indore: Woman Assaults Boyfriend on Road Over Alleged Cheating, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported from the Lasudiya police station area in Indore, where a woman publicly assaulted her boyfriend over allegations of infidelity. The incident took place near the Clifton Corporate Building in Scheme No.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported from the Lasudiya police station area in Indore, where a woman publicly assaulted her boyfriend over allegations of infidelity. The incident took place near the Clifton Corporate Building in Scheme No. 78 and was captured on video by a bystander, which has since gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the woman confronted her boyfriend on the road after discovering he was in contact with another girl. Claiming to be his wife, she slapped and beat him with slippers, kicked him in the chest, and even removed his pants in public.

The altercation reportedly lasted around 20 minutes. When bystanders attempted to intervene, the woman allegedly abused them as well. She eventually fled the scene on a bike with two other men.

No formal complaint has been filed yet. Additional DCP Rajesh Dandotia said the police are examining the viral video and further action will be taken based on the findings.

articles.title: Indore: Coach at Shooting Academy Accused of Sexual Harassment, POCSO Case Registered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of sexual harassment has emerged from Indore’s Dream Olympic Shooting Academy, where coach Mohsin Khan has been accused of molesting a female student. The incident has triggered outrage across the city.

body.html:
A shocking case of sexual harassment has emerged from Indore’s Dream Olympic Shooting Academy, where coach Mohsin Khan has been accused of molesting a female student. The incident has triggered outrage across the city.

The victim, a resident of Malharganj, alleged that on November 8, 2023, Khan inappropriately touched her during practice under the pretext of adjusting her rifle. When she resisted, he allegedly threatened to ruin her career. The student, who had been training at the academy since 2021, filed a police complaint with her brother after disclosing the incident to her family.

According to ACP Shivendu Joshi, a case has been registered under relevant sections of the POCSO Act and IPC. The accused is in custody, and further investigation is underway, including efforts to identify other potential victims.

Bajrang Dal claimed this was part of a larger conspiracy targeting Hindu girls. The organization alleged that over 150 such cases involving the accused have surfaced based on recovered phone data, including videos and messages. They have called for a probe into all affiliated academies and the coach’s family members, two of whom are also coaches.

The incident has prompted demands for stricter regulations and background checks for coaches in sports academies. Social groups and parents are calling for regular inspections, behavioral evaluations, and systemic safeguards to protect students.

articles.title: IndiGo Flight Faces Turbulence, Makes Emergency Landing in Srinagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: IndiGo flight 6E-2142 from Delhi to Srinagar encountered severe turbulence due to a hailstorm just before landing on Tuesday evening. The aircraft, carrying 227 passengers and crew, declared an emergency and landed safely at Srinagar airport around 6:30 PM.

body.html:
IndiGo flight 6E-2142 from Delhi to Srinagar encountered severe turbulence due to a hailstorm just before landing on Tuesday evening. The aircraft, carrying 227 passengers and crew, declared an emergency and landed safely at Srinagar airport around 6:30 PM.

The hailstorm damaged the aircraft's nose cone and caused luggage displacement inside the cabin. Many passengers described moments of fear, praying and later applauding the crew’s calm response.

All passengers are safe. The aircraft has been grounded for inspection, and IndiGo has launched an investigation.

Meanwhile, Delhi-NCR witnessed a dramatic weather shift on Wednesday evening, with dust storms, strong winds, hail, and rain sweeping through the region. Wind speeds hit 79 km/h, causing traffic disruptions, power outages, and scattered damage.

articles.title: Hyderabad Tragedy: Three Students Killed in Horrific Head-On Collision with Lorry, One Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a tragic road accident caught on CCTV, three students lost their lives and one sustained injuries when their speeding car collided head-on with a DCM lorry near Narayana College, opposite AEGIS LPG bunk in Hayathnagar, Hyderabad, during the early hours of Wednesday.

body.html:
In a tragic road accident caught on CCTV, three students lost their lives and one sustained injuries when their speeding car collided head-on with a DCM lorry near Narayana College, opposite AEGIS LPG bunk in Hayathnagar, Hyderabad, during the early hours of Wednesday.

The students, all aged between 23 and 24, were reportedly traveling from Pasumamula village to Kuntloor when the accident occurred on a curve. The lorry was coming from the opposite direction on the same stretch.

Victims Identified:
1. Chandrasena Reddy (24)
2. Trinadh Reddy (24)
3. Varshith Reddy (23)
All three died on the spot. One other student sustained serious injuries and was rescued by locals from the mangled vehicle.

Investigation Underway:
The Hayathnagar Police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident. Preliminary reports suggest speeding and loss of control on a curve may have led to the fatal collision.

articles.title: Ghaziabad: Salon Worker Arrested for Spitting on Cream Before Applying It to Customer’s Face
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident from Wave City, Ghaziabad has gone viral after a 24-year-old salon worker was caught on camera spitting on cream before applying it to a customer’s face during a facial.

body.html:
A shocking incident from Wave City, Ghaziabad has gone viral after a 24-year-old salon worker was caught on camera spitting on cream before applying it to a customer’s face during a facial.

The video, recorded at Level Up salon in Sector 5, shows the accused Arshad Ali squeezing cream into his palm, spitting on it, and then proceeding to apply it to the unsuspecting customer's face. The 23-second clip was reportedly filmed by a colleague or another customer and shared on social media on Sunday, prompting widespread outrage.

Taking swift action, Wave City police registered an FIR under BNS sections 271 (negligent act likely to spread infection) and 272 (malignant act likely to spread infection). Ali, a resident of Aslam Colony in Dasna, had joined the salon just a week prior to the incident. He was arrested on Sunday night.

ACP Priyashri Pal confirmed that the police traced the salon using video evidence and identified the accused. The incident has raised serious hygiene and safety concerns.

articles.title: 🇮🇳🇳🇵 Joint India–Nepal Team Scales Mt Kanchenjunga (8,586 m)!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a powerful show of friendship and military teamwork, a combined Indian & Nepali Army expedition has successfully summited the world’s 3rd highest peak. The team reached the top of Mt Kanchenjunga on 19 May at 07:40 AM IST, braving sub-zero temperatures and high winds.

body.html:
In a powerful show of friendship and military teamwork, a combined Indian & Nepali Army expedition has successfully summited the world’s 3rd highest peak. The team reached the top of Mt Kanchenjunga on 19 May at 07:40 AM IST, braving sub-zero temperatures and high winds.

Led by:
🔹 Col Sarfraz Singh (Indian Army)
🔹 Capt Prashant Khanka (Nepali Army)

Together, they unfurled their national flags in a symbol of enduring camaraderie. Trained at Gulmarg's High Altitude Warfare School, the nine-member team showcased grit, coordination, and trust.

🗻 Route: South-West Ridge
✅ No injuries reported
📍 Descent to Base Camp by 22 May expected

A proud moment reinforcing defence ties & adventure collaboration between India and Nepal! 💪🌏
